grants.description: Verify your identity as the qualified informant registering the birth
grants.purpose: To confirm you are authorized to register this birth and to create an accurate birth record

grants.description: Provide the baby's birth details for the official birth record
grants.purpose: To create the official birth registration and certificate for the child

grants.description: Provide both parents' details for the birth certificate
grants.purpose: To record parental information on the birth certificate and establish legal parentage

grants.description: Share the child's personal health record (red book) if available
grants.purpose: To cross-reference the birth registration with NHS records

grants.description: Share birth registration data with HMRC for Child Benefit eligibility
grants.purpose: To enable you to claim Child Benefit and Child Tax Credit without providing duplicate information

revocation.mechanism: Contact the General Register Office to request correction or amendment to the birth record
revocation.effect: Birth registration cannot be reversed, but corrections can be made through a formal amendment process. Registered information will remain on record.

delegation.limitations: Agent cannot register the birth on your behalf. Agent cannot provide false information. Agent cannot appear in person at the register office. The qualified informant must attend in person with required documents.
